state_contract.kind: structured continuous observations; no Q-table encoder or trained policy yet
state_contract.pose: explicit simulation_truth pool-fixed x/y metres and heading radians; confidence/uncertainty/time; not existing boat hardware
state_contract.motion: finite difference of simulated world displacement plus declared noise; m/s and rad/s; never derived by converting requested motor values
state_contract.clearance: eight synthetic body-relative rays at front, front-left, left, rear-left, rear, rear-right, right, front-right; metres
state_contract.feedback: simulation digital applied-control ACK; own control_sequence distinct from mission request sequence; not mechanical thrust proof
state_contract.target: synthetic bearing/range with legacy noise/dropout, not YOLO depth or physical camera
state_contract.range_evidence: separate current control-health receiver time and original range capture time; fresh/cached_wait/missing_wait/stale/invalid; cached values diagnosis only, never motor permission
state_contract.progress_evidence: independent pose displacement projected onto the original measured heading minus declared position/heading uncertainty; distinct pose times; no motor-to-velocity conversion and no confirmed-stall assertion

physics.scene_generator: frozen MemoryPoolEnv static geometry, gains and current distribution; never call its step or modify its files
physics.position_update: position += (heading_vector*u + passive_current)*dt in every mode, including STOP/manual/disarmed
physics.latency_ticks: legacy delay0..2 multiplied by3; 0/300/600ms retained at100ms dt
physics.collisions: same circle/wall geometry; remain possible under every mode; STOP and HOLD confer no immunity
physics.collection: only TRACKING with forward hull speed>0.15m/s, distance<0.5m and forward bearing<0.58rad; simulated only

observations.legacy_stress_retained: clearance noise +/-0.1m, sensor dropout2%, target dropout8%, bearing noise +/-0.16rad, range noise +/-0.25m

supervision.hold_required_evidence: fresh independently tagged pose+motion and all eight clearances>=0.65m; source/method/units/confidence/uncertainty checked
supervision.hold_algorithm: bounded synthetic position/integral/velocity feedback with heading alignment; untrained, non-hardware-calibrated
supervision.stop_semantics: immediate neutral motors and queue flush; passive current and hull coasting remain
supervision.manual_and_disarm: always neutral, clear pending mission/controls/anchor; old autonomous request cannot return
supervision.watchdog: no new live mission request means neutral and cleared queue; never retime the old request
supervision.receiver: recheck queued command expiry and direction clearance at application; delayed startup neutral
supervision.actuation_unavailable: missing/mismatched ACK or expired queued command latches assistance; cannot extend TTL to hide latency
supervision.recovery: only a neutral manual-assessment request, no autonomous unjamming/reverse escape controller
supervision.possible_stall: distinct fresh measured low-speed samples >=2s with matched forward-command ACK; excludes HOLD and pivots; does not identify all jams in flowing water
supervision.reset: explicit fresh disarmed operator reset; previous mission not restored
supervision.range_packet_absence: immediate neutral WAIT_RANGE_UPDATE and queue/mission cancellation; original cache timestamp kept for diagnosis only; fresh frame plus a new request required; >300ms loss becomes latched fault
supervision.invalid_range: explicit failure, malformed source/units, sequence conflict/regression or future clock clears cache and produces latched fault; no fallback to last good value
supervision.inconclusive_progress: after2000ms cumulative matched forward ACK time without >=0.08m conservative projected independent pose progress, neutral PROGRESS_UNCERTAIN and manual-assessment latch; do not claim confirmed stall
supervision.forward_time_accounting: short range waits pause matched-forward active time without erasing its independent evidence; STOP/HOLD/pivot/manual/disarm reset it
supervision.uncertainty_unchanged: stress velocity .008m/s and strict low-motion .015m/s threshold preserved; missing pose or unresolved uncertainty cannot be replaced with commanded motion

canonical_cases.role: development/unit cases for revision2; no frozen learner protocol or independent selection data

required_before_training: Freeze learner state/action encoding and explicit model schema; current environment has no learned policy
Freeze train/validation/test seeds that do not reuse exposed v3 test seeds; do not open test for selection
Freeze absolute collision/success/availability/timeout gates in addition to comparative gates
Give baseline and candidate the same physics, sensors and HOLD/RECOVERY supervisor; report extra observability separately from learning gains
Include noisy nominal/stress, latency expiry, missing rear/pose/motion/ACK, manual/disarm/watchdog cases without reducing difficulty
Record source hashes, hypothesis and bounded compute plan before any experiment
Any research candidate still requires readiness review; no production or physical rollout from canonical tests
